summary: A five-story commercial/research building at 1700 Owens Street in Mission Bay South, home to the UCSF-Bay Area Center for AIDS Research (CFAR) and the Taube-Koret Center for Huntington's Disease Research. DataSF's Assessor tax roll (block 8709, lot 007) records the building's construction year as 2007.
